name: Francis Mirror
source:
Abels childhoodfriend who just can't leave him alone and chased him to Voromia Academy.

Typical childhoodfriend who like to beat Abel up for every mistake he does, and can't just admit it that he likes him that way. Is also priest who believes in the machine god Dea Ex Machina. Also when she was young was sickly person and ABel was one of her only friends, values pendant given to him by Abel.
